subject: NAM kickoff — interpretable models for regulated customers
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kickoff for the Neural Additive Models effort. The open-source release gives us a tf.keras NAM model that drops into any training procedure, plus helpers for classification/regression graphs and a nam_train.py example script. The pitch: data-platforms customers in regulated domains keep asking for models where every feature's contribution is inspectable — NAMs give near-DNN accuracy with per-feature shape functions you can literally plot.

Deliverables this half: (1) a supported internal library wrapping the release, (2) tuned defaults per dataset family, which means large hyperparameter sweeps over the paper's benchmark suite (public sets live in the gs://nam_datasets/data bucket), (3) one lighthouse customer integration.

Note: the MIMIC-II medical benchmark needs a signed data use agreement — I've looped Kofi separately so Privacy Review starts now given their 2-3 week SLA.

Milestones: library alpha end of March, sweeps in June, customer readout by 07-06.

Dmitri
